note: Required runtime qualification scenarios, not executed lifecycle test results.

scenarios.setup: Fail after changing lifecycle state but before required audit/membership commit.
required_outcomes: The transaction rolls back state, membership and event together.
No fan-out success fact exists.

scenarios.setup: Make required canonical audit persistence unavailable.
required_outcomes: The transition fails and no completion is acknowledged.
A later retry cannot repeat an acknowledged irreversible effect.

scenarios.setup: Crash before/after attempt intent, provider success, verified observation, publication, source retirement and cleanup.
required_outcomes: Source authority survives until verified publication.
Recovery preserves the original event/attempt identities for already committed facts.
Unobserved provider outcomes are reconciled before recording success.

scenarios.setup: Crash before/after intent protection, physical removal and completion protection.
required_outcomes: Irreversible cleanup cannot outrun independent intent/membership protection.
Final acknowledgement cannot outrun protected completion/audit coverage.

scenarios.setup: Reconcile the same committed transition twice.
required_outcomes: The canonical event UUID is unchanged.
A genuine additional physical attempt has its own attempt UUID.

scenarios.setup: Commit an eligible version after an earlier batch selected older sequence values.
required_outcomes: A later eligibility pass selects the late commit.
No timestamp/sequence watermark silently excludes it.

scenarios.setup: Replace a worker claim before its provider result returns.
required_outcomes: The old worker cannot publish, retire, or acknowledge success.
Its observed external effect remains a bounded reconciliation obligation.

scenarios.setup: Revoke request/evidence authority between admission and result or membership access.
required_outcomes: Execution and every access recheck current authority.
Unauthorized lookup is indistinguishable from nonexistent lookup.

scenarios.setup: Operate on collections A/B while a reader and subscriber have A only.
required_outcomes: A gets its own event/operation identity and exact A-only membership/counts.
Summary, metadata, cursors, causation and every transport contain no B identity or count.

scenarios.setup: Create a hold or return a provider retention lock before retirement/deletion.
required_outcomes: A bounded blocker is recorded.
Transfer publication is not confused with source removal or erasure completion.

scenarios.setup: Keep an eligible sink unavailable while physical cleanup completes.
required_outcomes: Canonical audit persists and cleanup never waits for sink acknowledgement.
Retries/backlog are bounded and any delivery gap is inspectable.

scenarios.setup: Deliver revision 3 before revision 2, then redeliver 3.
required_outcomes: The consumer deduplicates event UUIDs and preserves operation revisions.
Transport success is never interpreted as domain completion.

scenarios.setup: Revoke a sink grant or subscription authority before retry admission.
required_outcomes: The retry does not begin transport.
Already admitted external work is not claimed recalled.

scenarios.setup: Remove one managed copy while another is locked or unavailable.
required_outcomes: Copy-level receipt and blocker remain separate.
No confirmed managed-scope completion is emitted.

scenarios.setup: Restore older application data reusing integer resource/principal IDs.
required_outcomes: Protected authority and exact UUID membership retain their identity.
Exposure stays quarantined until restrictions/evidence are reapplied.

scenarios.setup: Recover a primary behind acknowledged authority; also test stale and wrong-lineage independent evidence.
required_outcomes: Recovery fails closed for stale, missing or incompatible coverage.
Rebuilt audit projections preserve original event UUIDs.

scenarios.setup: Purge the original task and delete its principal/resource.
required_outcomes: Authorized minimal evidence is discoverable without a live task/resource.
Current records with reused integer IDs cannot supply historical attribution.

scenarios.setup: Expire or minimize exact membership while an authorized caller retains the event reference.
required_outcomes: The typed response distinguishes unavailable evidence from complete empty membership.
Unauthorized callers receive no tombstone, count or receipt disclosure.

scenarios.setup: Corrupt, truncate, or substitute a retained manifest or remove a required reader/dependency.
required_outcomes: No complete membership response is returned.
A typed corruption/unsupported/dependency failure is exposed after authorization.

scenarios.setup: Authorize a result download, then disconnect or fail verification before EOF.
required_outcomes: Authorization is not recorded as completed transfer.
No event claims user consumption or retention.

scenarios.setup: Read added optional fields/reasons and an unsupported name/version through every consumer mode.
required_outcomes: Unknown optional data is preserved without fabricated success.
Unsupported required semantics stay explicit.
Frontend/BFF, Rust async/blocking, Python sync/async and released-SDK CLI run the same fixtures.

scenarios.setup: Fill retained-row/byte and gap-slot ceilings; finish deliveries without purging their rows.
required_outcomes: Terminal status does not release retained storage reservations.
Full delivery capacity atomically coalesces an explicit gap; full gap-slot capacity rejects new opt-in.
Configured reductions drain existing reservations without changing recorded limits between replicas.

scenarios.setup: Fail the gap write during fan-out when delivery capacity is full.
required_outcomes: The event remains undispatched and retryable; replay does not double-charge or double-count.
Required audit facts are retained and physical lifecycle completion never waits for an external receiver.

scenarios.setup: Purge source audit rows and change configuration while a sink is unavailable or a capture is being built.
required_outcomes: Scoped source-retention generation advances atomically with purge.
The capture describes only its bounded committed set; source loss stays expired/unknown.
No empty or acknowledged response claims complete notification recovery.
Supported restore/recovery invalidates stale continuations through the verified application incarnation and marks unreconciled notification coverage unknown/recovery_gap.

scenarios.setup: Capture a fixed result, then commit an older-timestamp event and advance the gap revision.
required_outcomes: The new event uses ordinary fan-out and may appear in a later capture.
Reading the old capture cannot clear the newer gap or prove a time-window watermark.

scenarios.setup: Acknowledge the current gap and then race an acknowledgement with another omission.
required_outcomes: Acknowledgement records operator awareness only and preserves unavailable source history.
Stale expected revisions conflict and a later omission reopens the gap.
Configuration and scoped source-generation changes also conflict with the reviewed acknowledgement; success advances the gap revision and audits awareness only.

scenarios.setup: Purge original task details, disconnect, and return during the capture availability window; also exceed each capture limit.
required_outcomes: The same authorized capture/output remains discoverable and digest-bound while available.
Expired/unavailable results are typed failures, not empty success.
Candidate, input or output overflow stops before publishing a complete result.
